profile.overview: Bob is a fast and explosive Mishima-style character. His toolkit appeals to a lot of different playstyles; a crouchdash giving him good mobility and mixup options, strong counter hit tools, a plethora of string extensions, and some powerful moves in heat.
strengths: The Biggest Mishima: Sports all the tools of a Mishima despite not actually being one: 1,1,2, crouchdash, hellsweep, electric wind bob fist, demon paw heat engager
Jabber: Very strong pokes with good range, including some of the best lows in the game
Burn My Fat!: Has some extremely powerful heat moves, including a counter hit launching low hatchet kick, a 12 frame punish that floor breaks, and a just frame heat smash that deals 60 damage
Roar My Fists!: Excellent block and whiff punishment up until i15
weaknesses: Big Boy: His perfect physique comes at the cost of a bigger-than-average hurtbox
Tough To Digest: As with any Mishima, he requires quite a bit of skill to use effectively
Slow Cooker: His fastest standing launcher (not counting perfect CD1) starts at i17
Combo Breaker: His combos are pretty inconsistent overall, and his optimal routes require precise micro-dashes, crouch cancels and blue spark inputs
heat: Can use à la Carte moves (f+2,H.1+2,1, H.df+3+4, uf+1,2,H.2, BAL.1,H.4)
